# pai router

Local model router: start, stop, restart, status, run, stats

```
pai router <command>
```

A local router on 127.0.0.1:8790: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to it and /model picks the provider.

```sh
pai router status
pai router stats --since 1d
```

See also: `pai worker policy`, `pai providers`

### pai router start

Start the router in the background

```
pai router start
```

Starts the local model router (127.0.0.1:<router.port>). If it is already running, says so and does nothing.

```sh
pai router start
pai router status
```

See also: `pai router stop`, `pai router status`

### pai router stop

Stop the router

```
pai router stop
```

Stops the background router. If it is not running, says so.

```sh
pai router stop
pai router status
```

See also: `pai router start`

### pai router restart

Restart the router without refusing connections

```
pai router restart
```

Starts a new router that waits for the port, then stops the old one, which finishes its in-flight streams first. Prints the longest refused interval.

```sh
pai router restart
pai router status
```

See also: `pai router start`, `pai router stop`

### pai router status

Show whether the router is running

```
pai router status
```

Says whether the router runs and whether the daemon restarts it when it is down.

```sh
pai router status
pai router start
```

See also: `pai router start`, `pai router stop`

### pai router run

Run the router in the foreground

```
pai router run [options]
```

Runs the router in this terminal until you press Ctrl-C. `pai router start` uses this to run it in the background.
A port other than the default never touches the pid file.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--port PORT` | string | 8790 | Port to listen on |
| `--replace PID` | string | — | After warming up, stop this router (SIGTERM) and take over its port (used by `pai router restart`) |
| `--inherit-fds FDS` | string | — | Listen on already-open sockets (fd[,fd of the beyond-loopback listener]) handed over by a router that is being replaced; reports ready over IPC |
| `--usage-file PATH` | string | — | Read the cockpit's accounting from this file and record nothing (second instances) |
| `--wait-bind SECONDS` | string | — | Retry binding the port for up to this many seconds while another router still holds it (used by `pai router restart`) |

```sh
pai router run
pai router run --port 8791 --usage-file ./usage.jsonl
```

See also: `pai router start`

### pai router stats

Token and cache totals per provider and model

```
pai router stats [options]
```

Reads the router's usage log and prints totals, grouped by provider (default) or by session.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--since SPAN` | string | — | Only the last span, e.g. 30m, 1h, 2d |
| `--by KEY` | string | provider | Group by provider or session |

```sh
pai router stats
pai router stats --since 2d --by session
```

See also: `pai router status`
